BiblicalUsage: Baruth means food, and it appears once, when the psalmist says they gave him gall for his meat and vinegar to drink in his thirst.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that this single verse is remembered because the cross remembered it, when the same gall and vinegar were offered to the Suffering One.
